title: Don't expect much
text: Don't expect much. We have four mostly-indoor pets, and now that it's almost spring, the shedding has gotten out of control. Our entire downstairs is wood flooring, and I did not want to pull out our large vacuum every day to pick up the fur. I bought this hoping it would help with light day-to-day vacuuming. It's compact and convenient enough, and I do love that it's cordless. The suction on it is TERRIBLE, though - really, really disappointing. When I leave it on the "bare floor" setting, the suction is only strong enough to suck the fur to the machine, but not into the canister (leaving me with a big clump of fur and debris on the outside of the vacuum's mouth, which is just gross). It's much more effective when I turn on the carpet setting and at least the rotating brush helps propel the fur into the canister, BUT, using the carpet setting wears the battery down significantly. I can only use this vacuum for about 15 minutes straight with the roller spinning before the battery gets drained and the vacuum basically begins to moan and sputter. Also, this is good enough to vacuum up fur and hair/dust, but does a poor job at sucking up anything with more mass - I can hardly get it to pick up stray cat food kibbles or even pine needles that the dogs have tracked in. I'm disappointed this isn't a slightly more robust vacuum, but I suppose the cheap price indicates what you can really expect from this.
